Solution.S:
$$\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(7^x - 1)^4}{\tan\left(\frac{x}{k}\right) \cdot \log\left(1 + \frac{x^2}{3}\right) \cdot \sin 4x}$$

$$= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(7^x - 1)^4}{x^4} \cdot \frac{x^4}{\tan\left(\frac{x}{k}\right) \cdot \log\left(1 + \frac{x^2}{3}\right) \cdot \sin 4x}$$

$$= \left( \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{7^x - 1}{x} \right)^4 \cdot \frac{1}{\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\tan(x/k)}{x} \cdot \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\log(1 + x^2/3)}{x^2} \cdot \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 4x}{x}}$$

$$= \frac{(\log 7)^4}{\frac{1}{k} \cdot \frac{1}{3} \cdot 4} = \frac{(\log 7)^4}{\frac{4}{3k}} = \frac{3k(\log 7)^4}{4}$$

Given the limit equals $3(\log 7)^3$:

$$\frac{3k(\log 7)^4}{4} = 3(\log 7)^3 \Rightarrow \frac{k(\log 7)}{4} = 1 \Rightarrow k = \frac{4}{\log 7} = 4(\log 7)^{-1}$$

Thus the correct option is A.
